groups.name: Sauvignon Blanc
groups.lead: Vibrant and textured, balancing citrus, tropical fruit, minerality, and freshness with a style reminiscent of the great white wines of Bordeaux and Friuli.

groups.name: Sangiovese
groups.lead: Bright, energetic, and food-driven, offering notes of cherry, dried herbs, and Tuscan-like vibrancy with exceptional balance and age-worthiness.

groups.name: Nebbiolo
groups.lead: One of California's rarest and most compelling expressions of the varietal, showing rose petals, wild strawberry, tar, and savory earth in a style inspired by the Langhe hills of Piedmont.

groups.name: Estate Cabernet
groups.lead: Powerful yet refined, with layered dark fruit, graphite, and polished tannins that speak to the pedigree of the vineyard site.
